options.provenance: Independent segregation proof before any payload; old T2 not used even for exploratory profile
options.publication_value: Conditional on substantive multi-project/family support and honest claim scope
options.sample_size_status: Prospective adequacy assessment required, no arbitrary minimum invented
options.temporal_validity: Freeze chronological split, ancestor boundary, ties and OOF lineage
